en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 3.  The  narrator  was  present  near  Imam  Ja’far  Sadiq  (a.s.) when  there  was  a  discussion  about  illness.

Imam  said, “Treat  your  illness  with  Sadaqah.  Why  don’t  you  offer  a day’s food as Sadaqah? If the angel of death is ordered to take out the soul of a person and he pays Sadaqah, the angel of death is told to return.”
